#!/usr/bin/bash
# ldap-authorized-keys -- sshd's own AuthorizedKeysCommand script.
# Invoked as: /usr/bin/bash /usr/sbin/ldap-authorized-keys %u
# Queries live LDAP (via the svc-nslcd service-account bind, never the
# connecting user's own credentials) for %u's sshPublicKey attribute
# and prints each key on its own line for sshd to accept.
USERNAME="$1"
. /etc/ldap-authkeys.conf

while IFS= read -r line; do
	case "$line" in
	sshPublicKey:\ *)
		echo "${line#sshPublicKey: }"
		;;
	esac
done < <(/usr/bin/ldapsearch -x -LLL -o ldif-wrap=no -H "$LDAP_URI" -D "$BIND_DN" -w "$BIND_PW" \
	-b "$LDAP_BASE" "(cn=$USERNAME)" sshPublicKey 2>/dev/null)

Port 22
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key
PidFile /run/sshd.pid

UsePAM yes
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
PermitRootLogin no

AuthorizedKeysCommand /usr/bin/bash /usr/sbin/ldap-authorized-keys %u
AuthorizedKeysCommandUser authkeys

#!/usr/bin/bash
# jumpbox1's own startup wrapper -- runs as PID 1 directly (this
# project's minimal images have no real init), keeps both nslcd and
# sshd as its own real children (never exec()'d away) so neither ever
# becomes an orphan needing reparenting.
set -e

mkdir -p /run/sshd-empty /run/nslcd /etc/ssh /etc/skel

# Real host keys, generated once per container instance -- this
# project's own images ship no pre-baked ones (a real from-source
# build, never vendor a private key).
/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -A

/usr/sbin/nslcd -d &

# sshd's own privsep pre-auth child (where PAM -- and therefore
# pam_ldap.so's nslcd-socket conversation -- actually runs) chroot()s
# to --with-privsep-path (/run/sshd-empty), a real, standard OpenSSH
# security boundary that has nothing to do with LDAP -- so it can
# never see /run/nslcd/socket at its real path once chrooted. Hard-
# linking the socket's own inode into the same relative path under
# /run/sshd-empty (not a copy -- the exact same live, listening socket,
# just reachable from a second path on the same filesystem) is the
# standard, documented fix for this exact SSSD/nslcd-under-OpenSSH-
# privsep interaction, not a workaround for anything actually broken.
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
	[ -S /run/nslcd/socket ] && break
	sleep 0.2
done
mkdir -p /run/sshd-empty/run/nslcd
ln /run/nslcd/socket /run/sshd-empty/run/nslcd/socket

/usr/sbin/sshd -D -e &
wait -n
